headline: India's DPDP Act for Apps (2026): Deadlines, Consent, and a Readiness Check
description: India's DPDP Act reaches full enforcement in May 2027, with Consent Manager registration closing in November 2026. Score your app against 10 controls and see what to fix first.

itemListElement.name: India's DPDP Act for Apps (2026): Deadlines, Consent, and a Readiness Check

mainEntity.name: When does the DPDP Act actually take effect for apps?

acceptedAnswer.text: Enforcement is phased. The Data Protection Board has been in place since November 2025, Consent Manager provisions activate around November 2026, and full enforcement lands in May 2027. The practical deadline is earlier than the headline date, because consent, withdrawal and deletion are product features that need building and testing.

mainEntity.name: Does the DPDP Act apply to my app if my company is not registered in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you process the personal data of people located in India. The Act follows whose data you handle rather than where you are incorporated, and there is no revenue threshold or minimum user count exemption.

mainEntity.name: What does valid consent look like in an app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Specific, unbundled and affirmative. Each distinct purpose — analytics, marketing, location, third-party sharing — needs its own clear opt-in in plain language, defaulted off. A single checkbox at signup covering everything the app will ever do does not meet the standard.

mainEntity.name: Is soft-deleting a user record enough for a deletion request?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Flipping a deleted flag while retaining the data is not erasure, and neither is clearing your primary database while copies persist in analytics, backups, logs and third-party SaaS tools. Meeting deletion requests properly requires knowing every place a user's data has been copied to.

mainEntity.name: What should we do first if we are starting from nothing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Draw the data map: every field you collect, why you collect it, where it flows and how long you keep it. Every other control depends on that being accurate, and it usually takes less time than teams expect. Fix consent capture next, so the problem stops growing while you work.
